package.description: A lightweight selection assistant that brings copy, search, translate, summarize, explain, polish, and AI actions to any text you select.

en-US.description: A lightweight selection assistant that brings copy, search, translate, summarize, explain, polish, and AI actions to any text you select.
en-US.longDescription: TextLens is a lightweight selection assistant for Windows 10/11 x64. Select text anywhere and a floating toolbar offers copy, search, translate, summarize, explain, polish, Ask AI, and custom actions. Results stream in a window with Markdown, tables, and math support, with multi-provider and multi-model (OpenAI-compatible) connections, per-provider enable and disable, and switchable translation target languages.
en-US.name: TextLens
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Fixed bugs and logic errors found during a source review, covering selection handling, action execution, settings, and result windows across macOS and Windows.
- Improved toolbar and result-window opening speed by running initialization tasks in parallel. Added a shorter, smoother 90 ms fade-in transition.
- Improved streaming result playback and Markdown rendering. The display adapts to incoming content and shows the complete response when generation finishes.
- Improved Ask AI retry behavior. Retrying a failed response preserves the question and conversation history.
- Improved settings-save reliability so edits made during saving remain in the draft. Refined dialog focus handling and navigation to fields with validation errors.
- Prevented actions bound to disabled providers from running. On macOS, selection highlights are cleared after copying or searching succeeds, or after the result window appears successfully.
发布版本 0.4.3
- 修复源码审查中发现的潜在 bug 与逻辑错误，覆盖 macOS 和 Windows 的划词处理、动作执行、设置保存及结果窗口等功能。
- 优化工具栏和结果框的弹出速度，并行处理窗口初始化任务；采用更短、更流畅的 90 毫秒淡入过渡。
- 优化流式结果播放与 Markdown 渲染，显示节奏随内容到达情况自适应调整，并在生成结束后补齐完整响应。
- 改进问 AI 的失败重试行为，重试时保留原问题及对话历史。
- 提升设置保存可靠性，保留保存期间继续编辑的新草稿；改进弹窗焦点处理与校验错误字段定位。
- 阻止已绑定到停用服务商的动作继续执行；macOS 在复制或搜索成功、或结果窗口成功显示后，再延迟清除宿主应用中的选区高亮。

zh-CN.description: 轻量级划词助手，为选中的任何文字提供复制、搜索、翻译、总结、解释、润色与 AI 操作。
zh-CN.longDescription: TextLens 是一款适用于 Windows 10/11 x64 的轻量级划词助手。选中任意文字即可弹出浮动工具栏，提供复制、搜索、翻译、总结、解释、润色、问 AI 与自定义动作；结果窗口支持 Markdown、表格与公式的流式输出，支持多服务商、多模型（OpenAI-compatible）、服务商启停与翻译目标语言切换。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:

- 改进问 AI 的失败重试行为，重试时保留原问题及对话历史。
- 提升设置保存可靠性，保留保存期间继续编辑的新草稿；改进弹窗焦点处理与校验错误字段定位。
